title: Microsoft event debuts new AI-friendly hardware and Windows changes
summary: Microsoft unveiled new AI-focused hardware and Windows updates at its annual event, positioning AI as central to the company's future direction.
content: Get ready for more AI in your Windows and more AI on the desktop.

zh.title: 微软发布会推出新型AI友好硬件和Windows更新
zh.summary: 微软在年度发布会上推出了新型AI硬件和Windows更新，将AI定位为公司未来发展的核心。
